name: Tsukamoto Akari
source:
A cheerful and caring motherly wife. A full-time housewife.
She is a neighbor who lives across the street from the main character's apartment.
She has been taking care of the protagonist since he lost his job.

They have been married for about six years.
They were a friendly couple when they were married, but gradually she noticed that her husband was becoming more and more bored,
She wonders if this is a sign of fatigue, and tries to do something about it.

She is trying to cope with her husband's increasing lethargy.
